is_anopheles.evidence: The study uses Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles stephensi.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions the AKDR strain of An. gambiae carries the L1014F kdr mutation (page 2, Materials and methods).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper mentions the AKDR strain carries the L1014F mutation, but it does not report genotype counts, allele counts, or frequencies for any field-collected populations.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses laboratory-maintained colonies (Keele colony, AKDR strain) obtained from insectaries/BEI Resources, not field-collected mosquitoes.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical laboratory study on bromide toxicity.

sub_country_location.evidence: No field collection locations are reported.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No field collection dates are reported.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study uses standard laboratory colonies.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report field genotype data, so no supplement is needed for that purpose.

assessment.summary: This study investigates the larvicidal effects of bromide on laboratory colonies of Anopheles gambiae and other mosquito species. It is not a field study and does not report genotype frequencies for field populations.
exclusion_reasons: No field-collected populations used (only laboratory colonies).
No extractable genotype data for field populations reported.
